title: Deep learning-guided synthesis yields fluid ferroelectric molecules
summary: A graph variational autoencoder proposes molecules while learned classifiers and regressors, retrosynthesis and stock-inventory constraints guide selection. The journal version reports 11 first-generation materials characterized through mixture-based extrapolation and two additional materials selected in a second iteration that exhibited the ferroelectric-nematic phase in their neat state. The first arXiv version (2025-12-18) contained the first-generation mixture-based work, not the later neat-state confirmation; this draft uses the journal date for that result. Predictions have material errors, and the work does not establish device performance.
ai_technology: Graph variational autoencoder; graph neural-network ensembles; XGBoost

evidence.tested: Journal full text reports two second-round synthesized materials with neat-state ferroelectric-nematic phase; first 11 compounds were assessed through mixture-based extrapolation.
evidence.unknown: Transition predictions may differ substantially from observed values; independent replication and device performance not established.
evidence.ai_role: Generative and predictive graph models rank and propose molecules; inventory and retrosynthetic filters guide laboratory synthesis and characterization.

source_review.scope: Primary arXiv v1 PDF directly read and primary journal full text indexed on PMC; version-specific first-cohort versus second-round evidence reconciled.
